replies.author: Pavlo
replies.body:
I like this overall.
I like that it's not fully flat, and the layout is nice!
Although the islands, mainly the middle ones, are a tad bit too small. Try increase them in size, because it's no fun getting to the middle only to be knocked off 3 seconds later. Also a structure or something would be nice in the middle of the main spawn island :P

In the future, try to avoid posting pictures with only shaders.

Overall, looks promising!
